Senior Data Analyst
Acme Analytics
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Hybrid — 2 days per week in office

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to turn product data into decisions.
You will own dashboards, define metrics, and partner with product teams.

What we offer
Salary range: €55,000 - €70,000 per year depending on experience.
We are a recognised sponsor and can sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa.
25 vacation days, annual learning budget, pension plan.
